findings.title: T059 marked done but 002/data-model.md still documents retired CategoriaDocumento/TipologiaBandoSOL as live FK entities
findings.evidence: The 2026-09-17 preamble (lines 3-31) says FR-016 dismisses categorie/tipologie/classificazione and that 'le sezioni storiche sotto non autorizzano a reintrodurli', but the rest of the same file (Entities section) still fully defines '### CategoriaDocumento' (lines 80-97, fields codice_tipo_documento/codice/descrizione/attiva, validation 'una categoria non attiva non puo' essere usata...') and '### TipologiaBandoSOL' (lines 125-141, with the full TDPNRR/CD/DIR/... enumeration), and the Relationships block (lines 253-257) still shows 'TipoDocumento 1--N CategoriaDocumento', 'CategoriaDocumento 1--N ModelloDocumento', 'TipologiaBandoSOL 1--N ModelloDocumento'. Migration backend/alembic/versions/0009_ritiro_catalogo_esterno_locale.py (part of this same diff) drops the categoria_documento, tipologia_bando_sol and classificazione_catalogo tables and removes their FK columns from modello_documento entirely, replacing them with plain codice_categoria/codice_tipologia/percorso_categorizzazione fields (see backend/app/catalog/models.py ModelloDocumento). T059 in tasks.md is checked '[x]' as 'Riallineare il riferimento documentale alla porta condivisa ... alla porta canonica della 010', and only the Porta Di Discovery section was actually rewritten - the contradicting legacy entity/relationship sections were left in place.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite or delete the CategoriaDocumento/TipologiaBandoSOL Entities sections and the Relationships diagram in specs/002-builder-modelli/data-model.md so they reflect the current schema (codice_categoria/codice_tipologia/percorso_categorizzazione, no FK to a local classification table), consistent with specs/010-configurazione-cataloghi-integrazioni/data-model.md. A top-of-file disclaimer is not sufficient when ~150 lines of contradicting schema detail follow it - a reader or future implementer skimming the Entities/Relationships sections will design against tables that no longer exist.

findings.title: 001/data-model.md still describes the retired classification tables as a DB-backed 'cache locale', contradicting the in-memory-only cache this same diff implements
findings.evidence: Lines 12-18 state that for an integrated tipo documento (e.g. BANDO_CONCORSO) 'le righe sono una cache locale a TTL breve, popolate/aggiornate da un adapter HTTP che chiama l'endpoint di discovery registrato', and lines 24-29 say 'infra/local/postgres/seed-demo-catalog.yaml continua a esistere e a popolare queste tabelle' for CategoriaDocumento/TipologiaDocumento/RegistroContrattiDati. But backend/alembic/versions/0009_ritiro_catalogo_esterno_locale.py (this diff) drops categoria_documento, tipologia_bando_sol, classificazione_catalogo and registro_contratti_dati outright, and the actual AdapterHTTP cache (backend/app/discovery/cache.py CacheDiscovery) is explicitly process-memory only with a 60s TTL, never persisted to any DB table (confirmed by specs/010-configurazione-cataloghi-integrazioni/data-model.md and research.md, which repeatedly stress 'mai una tabella DB persistente'). specs/001 is listed in review_scope.included_features with review_status CHANGED/needs_review true, yet its data-model.md was not touched in this diff even though 001/tasks.md and 001/spec.md were updated with the FR-016 riallineamento note.
findings.recommendation: Update specs/001-catalogo-contratto-geban/data-model.md to remove the 'cache locale a TTL breve' / DB-table framing for integrated tipo documento and state plainly that classification data now lives only in the in-memory CacheDiscovery (010), with zero DB persistence; also clarify that infra/local/postgres/seed-demo-catalog.yaml's categorie/classificazioni/tipologie_sol sections are legacy fixtures consumed only by the quality-gate validator (backend/app/quality/seed_demo.py), not live seed data for tables that exist anymore.
